rule: Resource-DoS review may close the security-review obligation while preserving explicit performance/device-floor gaps under P7/P15. It must not claim browser heap or weak-device guarantees that are not measured.

surfaces.review: Concurrent guest workers are authority-leased and bounded; runaway guest execution has a hard termination path.
Process output is capped independently from process count; oversized guest-to-host results fail closed.
Compressed package expansion is bounded during streaming before unbounded decompressed buffering; archive file count and unpacked bytes are independently capped.

Source maps are generated/handled inside the isolated toolchain path and are not promoted to a new trusted parser or canonical-data authority. Large map generation can still consume toolchain-worker memory.
controls: no source-map authority exposed to guest host capabilities
surfaces.residualRisk: No weak-device source-map memory ceiling is proven; P7 resource/weak-device campaigns remain open.

surfaces.review: WASM artifacts are exact-byte-length and SHA-256 profile bound before compilation, but browser WebAssembly heap growth is not directly metered by ResourceGovernor.
surfaces.residualRisk: Actual browser WASM heap growth has no independently proven device-floor ceiling; this remains a P7/P15 evidence limitation rather than being hidden.

boundaries: This review is about security DoS boundaries, not throughput or weak-device performance certification.
A browser heap/WASM memory floor is not claimed.
P7 weak-device, long-run plateau and memory-pressure campaigns remain open.
